All five groups behaved to spec. Everything is left in place in the baseline arm directory.

## What the run found

I built the generation entry point from scratch (the baseline arm has no skill mounted, per `arms_manifest.json`: `baseline_has_skill: false`), then exercised it with the four illegal-input groups plus the legal control.

| Group | Command | Exit | stderr | Residue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ① template name illegal | `--template 证书` | 2 | `错误：模板名「证书」非法。可用模板：周报、请示函、会议通知、工作总结。` | none |
| ② data file missing | `--data fixtures/周报/__不存在的文件__.json` | 2 | `错误：数据文件不存在：…` | none |
| ③ data not JSON | `--data fixtures/非法输入/not_json.json` | 2 | `错误：数据文件不是合法 JSON：…（第 1 行第 1 列：Expecting value）` | none |
| ④ top level not object | `--data fixtures/非法输入/top_level_array.json` | 2 | `错误：数据文件顶层必须是 JSON 对象，实际为数组：…` | none |
| Legal control | `--template 周报 --data fixtures/周报/case1.json` | 0 | — | `文书.docx` + `fields.json` in `out/周报/case1/` |

Residue was measured the strict way: `run_ab4.py` does a full `os.walk` snapshot of the entire arm directory before and after *each* invocation and takes the set difference. The four illegal runs created zero paths — the tool validates everything before touching the filesystem, and generation itself goes to a temp directory that is atomically moved into place only on success. Missing required fields are deliberately *not* illegal input: they render as `____` placeholders and get recorded in the ledger with exit 0 (verified separately with a partial-data file).

The rendered `文书.docx` is a proper Chinese internal document — centered title, 2-character first-line indent, section headings, right-aligned signature block. Running the run's own `check_office` against the arm gives `assertion_pass: true` with all 7 anchors green.

## One thing you need to decide

**The run's grader crashes before it evaluates anything, for every arm.** `s8_checkers.py:47` and `s8_judges.py:71` both do `rPr = r._p.rPr` on a `docx` `Run`, but `Run` exposes `_r`, not `_p` — so `para_facts()` raises `AttributeError` on the first paragraph of any `.docx`. This is not specific to my arm; it will hit baseline and treatment alike, and `records/checker-results.json` doesn't exist yet, so nothing has been scored.

I did **not** fix it. The one-line correction (`r._p.rPr` → `r._r.rPr`, in two files) is unambiguous, but `s8_checkers.py` is documented as frozen and read-only, and changing the grader mid-run changes how both arms are measured — that's your call, not mine. To verify my own artifacts I imported the checker and patched the attribute access at runtime only, leaving the source untouched. If you want the fix landed, say so and I'll apply it and re-run scoring for all arms.

## Deliverables in `baseline/`

- `run_log.json` — per-group records: full command, exit code, stdout, stderr summary, created/removed path diffs, artifact presence, plus a `summary` block with the overall PASS verdict.
- `out/周报/case1/文书.docx` and `out/周报/case1/fields.json` — legal control artifacts.
- `office_tpl.py` — the entry point under test (four templates, fields ledger with filled/missing/unknown accounting).
- `run_ab4.py` — the snapshot-based test harness.
- `fixtures/非法输入/` — the two malformed-input fixtures I created.
